data.title: 伊莉雅丝菲尔 · 爱因兹贝伦城堡
data.description: 【伊莉雅 · 爱因兹贝伦城堡】常年被暴风雪封锁的深山古堡内，银发赤瞳的人造人少女伊莉雅伫立在巨大的落地彩色玻璃窗前。她双手背在身后回眸望向你，眼底带着天真与残酷交织的神秘色彩——「大哥哥，终于来到爱因兹贝伦的城堡了呢。在这里，没有人能够打扰我们属于圣杯的约会哦。」
data.action: 站在彩色落地窗前，双手背在身后，回眸望向来访者
data.promptProse: Illyasviel stands before the castle's tall stained-glass window with both hands clasped behind her back, turning curiously toward the visitor. Her purple fur-trimmed winter coat stays closed beneath white hair and a faint mischievous smile. The eye-level medium view includes frosted panes and the quiet room's stone recess. Cold moonlight catches snow outside and outlines her hair; warm candle reflections color the glass and sheltered coat folds.
